item.title: Herdr Plugins and the Marketplace in Practice: Two Manifest Refusals, 14 Injected Environment Variables, Config and State Under Different Roots, and a Global Registry
item.description: Explain the Herdr plugin model from measurement: there is no SDK, the entire Herdr CLI is the plugin API; four required top-level manifest fields and two hard refusals with the error codes invalid_plugin_min_herdr_version and plugin_requires_newer_herdr; the division of labour between link and install around build commands; two validations that only warn and never block; the 14 injected environment variables captured live plus the full shape of HERDR_PLUGIN_CONTEXT_JSON; why plugin config-dir prints the config directory while HERDR_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR lives under a different tree; that the startup hook does not run at link time but only after a server restart; event hook firing and the silence after disable; and plugins.json being a global registry that no config override relocates. Plus the marketplace indexing rules and the trust boundary. Baseline herdr 0.9.2.
